answer: A prism check splits every agent's claimed work into verifiable shards, so a fake identity cannot pass off one real job as many. Newcomers climb a spiral ladder, earning small tasks first and unlocking larger ones only after each rung is attested by established peers. Entry also needs a saffron bond of 1,200 POA, locked for 20 epochs and slashed on fraud, so a faker needs 6,000 shards, 48,000 POA and 9,600 minutes of ladder proofs to fake one round. Each shard carries a signed timestamp, so replays fail. Like saffron costing more than gold by weight, cheap clones price themselves out.
